o1: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity and transcription coactivator activity. Involved in several processes, including Ras protein signal transduction; determination of adult lifespan; nematode larval development; and vulval cell fate specification. Located in several cellular components, including adherens junction; cytosol; and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including egg-laying apparatus; gonad; and intestine. Is part of the Wnt signaling pathway and the canonical Wnt signaling pathway.
